Our Story

A table set forevery craving.

Demo Website is a cafe and restaurant in Hayathnagar built around one simple idea — that good food deserves a beautiful setting. Our kitchen moves comfortably between worlds: creamy continental pastas and loaded pizzas, wok-tossed Chinese favourites, slow-sealed dum biryani and indulgent shakes.

Everything we serve comes from a hygienic kitchen with fresh ingredients and real attention to flavour. Whether it is a quick burger, a long family lunch or a late dessert with friends, the promise stays the same: bold flavours, a premium experience, and a reason to come back.

Good to know

Questions,answered.

Do you have vegetarian options?

Yes — every dish on the menu is marked as vegetarian, contains egg, or non-vegetarian, and the filter above the menu lets you view only what you like.

What kinds of food do you serve?

Continental, Chinese, biryani, burgers, tacos, wraps, pizza, pasta, sea food, desserts, mojitos and thick shakes.

Where can I find you?

4-9-181/2/4, Lecturers Colony, Hayathnagar, Hyderabad, Telangana 501505 — tap Get Directions below for live maps and hours.

Are the prices in rupees?

Yes, all prices are in Indian rupees (₹). Where a dish has several options, each one is shown beside its price.
